facts.fact: The National ID Program's Fayda page describes online e-KYC authentication in use, where service providers request a Fayda number and the customer confirms by one-time code, with facial and fingerprint options in VeriFayda 1.0 and 2.0.

The page offers Fayda eSignet single sign-on through OpenID Connect for applications across platforms, an online e-KYC channel and an offline QR channel on the Fayda credential, with a partner portal onboarding organisations.

systems.platform: OpenID Connect SSO and e-KYC APIs

ETH.note: No public register keyed on the ID stated; linking to banks, telecom and medical records is only being worked towards.

facts.fact: The National ID Program's page describes Fayda Identification Numbers and Fayda credentials in use, verified online and offline.
The National ID Program says service providers can perform e-KYC against a customer's Fayda number through its portal, with one-time-code consent, and retrieve the customer's e-KYC data.

ETH.note: Banks, telecom and medical records are only being worked towards.
